title: The parcel's paper
logline: Brown paper folded square on the drafting table, the string wound neatly beside it, and what was in it not on the page. A parcel came; the page keeps the wrapping and reserves the gift.

panels.composition: A square of folded brown paper on a drafting table with a length of string wound neatly beside it, the lamp, nothing else on the table.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a square of folded brown paper on a drafting table with a length of string wound neatly beside it under a lamp, nothing else on the table, no words
image.notes: Contents reserved. A second parcel comes at ro_2025-11-23.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The wrapping kept; the gift reserved.
